text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you tell me how long you have been experiencing these nosebleeds and skin spots, and have you noticed any bleeding from your gums or other mucous membranes?

text: The nosebleeds and the little red spots on my hands and feet have been happening for a few weeks now. Yes, my teeth bleed sometimes when I brush them, too.
